claims.body: On shot quality, Dallas is one of the league’s best, but Nashville is one of the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. The more dangerous chances should be the Stars’.

NSH.head: Too close to call
NSH.body: Dallas has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, but they are on the second night of a back-to-back, and Nashville has home-ice advantage. The Predators can tip it if they keep shots to a minimum.
